facts.business: Gokul Agro Resources Limited operates in the edible oils and agri-commodities sector, engaged in integrated sourcing, processing, and marketing of edible oils and non-edible oils.
facts.related_party_note: Loans and advances to related parties stood at Rs 3,112.23 lakh as at March 31, 2026 (Rs 2,850.40 lakh as at March 31, 2025).
